description: Intent i023 (net-epidx, snapshot s06) complete. Searched drivers/net/usb/** and all USB NICs under drivers/net/wireless (drivers/net/wwan does not exist in s06) for probe/bind reads of altsetting[i].endpoint[k].desc without a preceding bNumEndpoints > k check. Four reported findings with exact source evidence: (1) s06:drivers/net/usb/lan78xx.c:3582-3592 (high confidence) — lan78xx_probe takes fixed indices endpoint + 0/+1/+2 from cur_altsetting with no bNumEndpoints check (only use in driver is the scan loop bound at 2770 in lan78xx_get_endpoints, which validates a different altsetting), then dereferences ep_intr->desc.bEndpointAddress to build pipe_intr and bInterval for usb_fill_int_urb, sizing the kmalloc'd interrupt buffer via usb_maxpacket; core config.c:494-497 leaves the array NULL when num_ep==0. (2) s06:drivers/net/wireless/ath/ath9k/hif_usb.c:1218-1232 (medium) — send_eject_command, dispatched at probe for STORAGE_DEVICE (0cf3:20ff), scans r=1 then 0 over altsetting[0].endpoint[] with no bNumEndpoints check in the file; first iteration reads endpoint[1].desc and the OOB bEndpointAddress programs usb_sndbulkpipe. (3) s06:drivers/net/wireless/zydas/zd1211rw/zd_usb.c:1277-1291 (medium) — eject_installer, the original of the ath9k copy, same unchecked r=1-first scan, called at probe for DEVICE_INSTALLER IDs (0x0ace:0x2011/0x20ff). (4) s06:drivers/net/usb/r8152.c:1352-1355 with use at 1430-1434 (medium) — alloc_all_mem takes alt->endpoint + 2 and reads ep_intr->desc.bInterval to fill the interrupt URB; zero bNumEndpoints occurrences in r8152.c (this tree lacks the probe-time <3 check present in sibling snapshots). One unresolved candidate: qmi_wwan.c:304 takes control-interface endpoint[0] unconditionally when control != data; the NULL check at 307 does not validate bounds and the wdm registration dereference path was not traced end-to-end. Evidence-backed negatives recorded for ~18 drivers whose endpoint scans are bounded by bNumEndpoints (usbnet.c:116 usbnet_get_endpoints shared bind path, cdc_ether.c:293 guarded, cdc-phonet.c:352-357 validated, sierra_net.c:696 rejects !=3, hso/cdc_ncm/ipheth, and all wireless drivers carl9170/at76c50x/brcmfmac/orinoco/p54/libertas/libertas_tf/mwifiex/mt7601u/rt2x00/rtl8xxxu/rtlwifi/rsi loop-bounded; ath10k/ath6kl/ath9k-htc endpoint arrays are driver-internal HTC structures, excluded). Limitations: no compilation or gadget reproducer run (static source hypotheses); eject paths need spoofed IDs and yield OOB read feeding a pipe address, no write primitive; r8152 triggers at open not probe; qmi_wwan trace incomplete. Artifact: agent-state/findings/i023.json (JSON-validated).
